query:
SELECT ci.id, ci.invoiceNumber, ci.clientAccountId, ci.totalAmountCents, ci.status,
       ca.clientName, ca.businessName, ca.assignedTechnicianId, ca.referredByTechnicianId
FROM client_invoices ci
JOIN client_accounts ca ON ca.id = ci.clientAccountId
WHERE ca.businessName LIKE '%Dojo%' OR ca.businessName LIKE '%dojo%' OR ca.businessName LIKE '%Mydojo%'
ORDER BY ci.id;
